snippet.description:
• Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3951680/The_Floor_Above?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=1
• A story-driven anomaly horror where you wake up strapped to a chair in a looping room. Rotate, blink, and choose your way through a nightmare where not every anomaly is real.
